wiki.title: Darkthorne
wiki.text:
Darkthorne (known as Princess Lavender) is the queen of Briarwood, and the sister of Queen Valerian.

She began ruling over Briarwood after the assassination of her parents, Geoffrey, Valerian's loyal and most trusted advisor, blamed Lavender and the Chugawugs and they were exiled. She stole half the Heartseed from the Royal Palace and took it to Briarheart, where Lavender tore the Heartseed apart and grew a new version of the World Tree and named it Briarheart Palace. She then assumed the name of Darkthorne, Ayani's twin sister.

In the Free Realms comic series, it is explained how Darkthorne was blamed by Geoffrey for poisoning her sister Queen Valerian. We learn that this is false, and at the end of the issue 6, it is explained how Geoffrey had poisoned Queen Valerian. It cames out to a happy ending where Darkthorne and the two protagonists, Dane, and Maya get an antidote to Queen Valerian and save her. Darkthorne disappears seconds before Queen Valerian wakes up.
